Product out of warranty - estimate approved and billed to the customer

Customer / dealer asks for spares only

Companies.Address: Plot No. 32, Ecotech-1, Extension-1, Greater Noida, Gautam Buddha Nagar ,Uttar Pradesh 201310, India
Companies.WarrantyTerms:
1. Warranty is given on each component separately (pump, motor and controller) from the date of installation / registration.
2. The warranty covers manufacturing defects only. Damage due to dry running, low or high voltage, lightning, flooding, sand / silt in water, wrong wiring, tampering or use of non-genuine spares is not covered.
3. The product serial numbers on the stickers must match this card. Warranty is void if a sticker is removed or damaged.
4. A defective unit found in warranty is repaired or replaced free of charge; the balance warranty of a replaced unit is carried to the new unit.
5. Transport, rig / crane hire for lifting the pump from the borewell and site charges are as per the service charge list unless agreed otherwise.
6. For service, call the toll-free number or raise a call from the Solartive warranty portal with the pump serial number.

Complaints.ComplaintText: Controller cooling fan making loud noise and unit heating
Complaints.Resolution: Cooling fan replaced; controller tested for one hour under full sun

Complaints.ComplaintText: Water leaking back from the pipe, low discharge
Yearly preventive maintenance visit
Complaints.Resolution: Preventive service done, all readings normal

Complaints.ComplaintText: MPPT tracking low, pump runs slowly in full sun
Motor winding burnt, motor not running
Complaints.Resolution: Motor replaced with a new unit; balance warranty carried to the new motor

Complaints.ComplaintText: Motor tripping again and again
Complaints.Resolution: Damaged motor lead cable replaced and jointed

Complaints.ComplaintText: Pump delivering less water than before
Motor bearing noisy and heating up
Complaints.Resolution: Bearing and seal replaced; customer paid the estimate

Complaints.ComplaintText: Controller does not detect the solar panels after installation
Complaints.Resolution: DC polarity corrected at the junction box and set commissioned

Complaints.ComplaintText: Low discharge, pump not lifting water properly
Controller display going blank now and then
Pump is noisy and vibrating
Complaints.Resolution: Bearing bush kit replaced, vibration gone

Complaints.ComplaintText: Pump is not lifting water
Complaints.Resolution: Duplicate call - the dealer has booked the same problem again

Complaints.ComplaintText: Water found in the motor oil and motor is tripping
Pump jammed, no water coming from the borewell
Complaints.Resolution: Impeller and bush replaced, pump running normally

Complaints.ComplaintText: Controller not powering on after the thunderstorm
Complaints.Resolution: SPD and capacitor replaced, controller working

Over-current error E04 shown on the controller

Motor burnt and pump shaft broken

MPPT not tracking; frequency stays low even in full sun
Pump delivers sand with the water and the motor is heating

Water discharge has reduced a lot since last week
Controller display is blank and the pump does not start in the morning

Motor trips after about ten minutes of running
